description.text: TechNexus builds venture ecosystems connecting Fortune 1000 corporations with high-growth startups — 150+ portfolio companies, $4B+ value since 2007.

targetApplicants.text: TechNexus partners with leading corporations and ambitious founders to invest in, build, and scale ventures that transform industries. Our insight comes from the connected entrepreneurial ecosystems . We have been mentoring, building and funding ventures since 2007, and putting our own capital and founder ethos to work alongside yours since 2017.

sources.quote: The first-of-its-kind venture collaborative — pioneered in 2007, with 150+ portfolio companies and $4B+ in tracked portfolio value. TechNexus partners with leading corporations and ambitious founders to invest in, build, and scale ventures that transform industries. Our insight comes from the connected entrepreneurial ecosystems . We have been mentoring, building and funding ventures since 2007, and putting our own capital and founder ethos to work alongside yours since 2017. 150+ Active Portfolio Investments More than a Dozen Corporate Partners Two Decades Curating Entrepreneurial Ecosystems $4B+ Follow-on Capital Raised by Portfolio Companies What We Do For Corporations TechNexus invests our resources aligned with yours and coordinates co-investments where it matters Venture strategy through a startup & emerging-tech lens Venture building — co-creating new companies from scratch Corporate spinouts from dormant R&D and IP Learn more For Ventures
